name: FPGA-BoardlessBench Dev Container
postCreateCommand: [ -x /usr/local/bin/fbb ] || ln -sf "${containerWorkspaceFolder}/bin/fbb" /usr/local/bin/fbb; [ -f /etc/bash_completion.d/fbb ] || cp "${containerWorkspaceFolder}/scripts/fbb_completion.bash" /etc/bash_completion.d/fbb; (npm --prefix dashboard install && npm --prefix dashboard/client install && npm --prefix dashboard/client run build || true)
